name: RenewableCertificateRegistry
tagline: REC, GO and I-REC inventory, transfers and retirements – with double-count and Scope 2 checks built in.
description: A complete energy attribute certificate desk for Power Apps and Power Pages: track issued batches by registry, device and vintage, reserve them for customers, follow transfers until the registry confirms them and retire them with vintage-window and market-boundary checks. Partial moves split batches by serial range, overlapping serials are caught before they are double counted, and every customer gets claim coverage and a retirement statement.
features: Status workflow from issuance to retirement
Scope 2 vintage window and market boundary checks
Expiry warnings and value at risk
Customer claim coverage and retirement statements
Bulk reserve, transfer, retire and CSV export
controlType: standard (2 controls: RenewableCertificateRegistry data-set + RenewableCertificateRegistryPortal field control)
